description: Weights and thresholds for combining passive evidence into an OS guess. README.md section 'Confidence scheme' explains the algorithm; reference/kitsune_fp.py implements it.

ip_ttl.why: Initial TTL is a stack default, but many stacks share each value and some hosts change it.

tcp_syn.why: The SYN layout comes from the kernel, but VPNs, proxies, NAT and tuning can change window and MSS.

dhcp_option55.why: The DHCP client is part of the OS and the order of the parameter request list rarely changes.

dhcp_vendor_class.why: Most DHCP clients send a fixed vendor class; it can be configured but rarely is.

http_user_agent.why: Any program can send any User-Agent, and browsers freeze or reduce the OS part.

http_server.why: Admins can hide or change the Server header, and a reverse proxy may answer instead of the host.

ssh_banner.why: Distribution packages put their own suffix in the banner; changing it needs a rebuild.

smb_native_os.why: SMB1 session setup carries the OS name the host reports about itself.

ntlmssp_version.why: NTLMSSP messages carry the Windows major, minor and build number.
